guest_message: When does my stay start and how long is it?
evidence:
[Manual 20.3 — Long stays]
House manual > 20. Tips for Different Kinds of Guests > 20.3 Long stays

- The maximum stay is 28 nights per booking; longer stays need the host's approval (section 2.7).
- Book mid-stay cleaning visits in advance (section 15.3) and use the free towel exchange at the front desk (section 9.2).
- Studio guests use the shared laundry room for longer stays (section 9.1).
- Pay attention to the monthly smog season (section 16.1) and the winter heating notes (section 7.2).

[Manual 15.3 — Mid-stay cleaning]
House manual > 15. Extras and Requests > 15.3 Mid-stay cleaning

A cleaning visit during your stay costs **PKR 3,000 per visit**, including fresh bed linen and towels. Book it **24 hours ahead**. The cleaners work between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM, and someone should be in the apartment or let us know where the valuables are.

[Guide Lahore > Sleep]
Lahore > Sleep

For the visitor there are three broad options of areas in which to stay

In or near the old town - has the advantage of having all the historical sights on your doorstep - however you are then limited for evening entertainment unless you want a long tuktuk ride. However the two 'rooftop' restaurants overlooking the mosque are nearby.

Along Mall Road probably in one of the big and expensive chain hotels - you will be equidistant from the old town and the nightlife

In Gulberg or Defense - where you have nice restaurants and shopping on your doorstep, and are closer to the airport.

These tradeoffs are important because of Lahore's awful traffic, and you want to minimise the amount of (daytime especially) travel in the city.  Sunday mornings are very quiet however and this is a good time to visit Mall Road and the old town.

Hotels and guesthouses are the two main options in the city. Hotels are a bit more expensive but usually have western-style toilets and are cleaner.

[Guide Lahore > Do]
Lahore > Do

These can be found at Fortress Stadium and Sozo Water Park (Jallo).

Enjoy street food and local special treats in the aptly named 3 Gawalmandi Food Street and 4 Anarkali Food Street.

Wagah Border Ceremony, Grand Trunk Road, Wagah. Daily 4:15 PM or 5:15 PM depending on the season. A patriotic and energetic display of military showmanship between India and Pakistan, known for its loud atmosphere and extended wait times. The experience is unique and memorable, though the long wait can be tiring. Entry is free. If coming from Wagah at the Pakistani border, take a cycle-rickshaw (Rs 15, 3 km) to the Attari station, where you can catch a local bus to Amritsar (Rs 15, 25 km). Taxis also use this route and charge around Rs 200 (800 from the Raja Sansi Airport) for the entire vehicle. (updated July 2024)
